ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.22 ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; predominantly dark ventral surface with high-contrast white regions localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation localized at the outer lateral tips of both lobes. Left lobe exhibits irregular white mottling at the extreme lateral margin. Right lobe features a large, contiguous white patch extending from the distal edge inward approximately 25% of the lobe's horizontal span.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 48 degrees; depth of depression is approximately 15% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern. The right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged peaks. The left lobe trailing edge contains a distinct macro-scale indentation (large missing segment) on the outer third of the span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concavity originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered circular white-on-black pixel groups (consistent with barnacle attachment scars) localized at the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 5-6 parallel, thin, horizontal white linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the dark pigmented area of the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/missing tissue segment on the upper outer trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive white scarring across the entirety of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of fine white speckling/mottling at the interior border where the large white right-tip patch meets the dark central pigmentation.
